standard-dialogue-first-talk.npc: Hi, welcome to Gnomeball. It's pretty simple really: You take the ball from me, charge at the gnome defence and try to throw the ball through the net using your ranged skill.
It's a rough game but great fun. It's also great for improving agility. So do you fancy a game?

steps.npc: You may be right, we've seen humans die on this field.

options.text: Okay then, I'll have a go.

steps.player: Okay then, I'll have a go.

steps.npc: Great stuff! There are few rules to Gnomeball, so it can get a bit rough.
You can pass to the green winger gnomes. Then you can make a run and they'll pass back. Otherwise, if you're feeling brave, you can just charge and dodge.
The main aim is to leave with no broken limbs. I think you should be fine.
Peeeeeeeeep
